call_points.text: Management remains comfortable that FY27 will perform better than FY26 despite geopolitical uncertainties.
EBITDA margin is targeted to recover by at least 160 bps in the medium term.
FY27 expected to be a better growth year than FY26, but management declined to give a numeric revenue guidance.
FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 16%-16.1%, balancing AI-led efficiency against client price cuts and AI investment.
12-month backlog closed at $300.4 million, up 13.5% YoY in USD and 24.4% in INR; management expects it to execute within 12 months.
U.K. renewals were signed at 10%-15% discounts, and management said discounts could go higher as AI reduces effort.
Operating cash flow for FY26 was ₹542 Cr, up 35% YoY; cash rose 51% to ₹938 Cr.
Final dividend of ₹16 per share declared, on top of ₹8 interim, totalling 480% of face value.
Effective tax rate guided at 24.5%-24.7% going forward, after a Q4 provision reversal lowered the rate.
AI-led deals now represent 9% of the order book, up from 3% two quarters ago, but average deal size is around $1 million.
M&A focus shifting to domain capabilities; management is actively looking at best use of growing cash.
FCA deal has started ramping up with more than 60 on-site resources; full ramp expected by end of Q1.

operating_notes.text: 12-month order backlog was $300.4 million at end-FY26, up 13.5% YoY in USD and 24.4% in INR.
AI-led deals represented 9% of the order book, up from 3% two quarters earlier, with average deal size around $1 million.
U.K. public sector contracts have 3-5 year tenures; Salesforce and Oracle project orders typically run 1-1.5 years.
Received final income tax assessment order for FY22-23 with total additions of ₹123.58 Cr.
Completed sale of Chennai property during the quarter, generating a net gain of ₹4,726 lakhs.
Q2FY27 12-month order backlog closed at $286.2 million, down 7.7% QoQ due to deferred project starts.
Expanding Trichy center to accommodate 150-200 professionals.
Focus areas for Trichy center include Salesforce, Oracle, and Data & AI.

timeline.summary: On its 20 April 2026 Q4FY26 earnings call, Mastek guided FY27 to grow faster than FY26 without a number and held its EBITDA margin guide at 16%-16.1%.
Mastek entered into an MOU on 24 April 2026 to sell a commercial building in Chennai for ₹60 crore.
Mastek received a final income tax assessment order for FY22-23 with total additions of ₹123.58 Cr on May 30, 2026.
Mastek Limited’s **Reena Raje** and **Abhijit Raj** to hold Non-Deal Roadshow on October 26, 2026, in Mumbai (physical/one-on-one/group).
Mastek Limited’s **Abhijit Raje** and **Reena Raje** will conduct a Non-Deal Roadshow on October 27, 2026, in Mumbai (physical/one-on-one/group).
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,018.68 Cr (+8.3% YoY), net profit ₹105.67 Cr (+8.4% YoY).
Mastek Limited provided a link to the audio recording of its Earnings Conference call held on 26 October 2026.

Mastek reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,018.7 Cr (+8.3% YoY) and net profit of ₹105.7 Cr, while 12-month order backlog declined 7.7% sequentially to $286.2 million due to delayed project starts.
Mastek announced the expansion of its Trichy technology center to accommodate 150-200 professionals focused on AI, Oracle, and Salesforce.

watchlist.response: Management declined to give a number, saying only that FY27 will be better than FY26.
watchlist.text: Revenue growth was only 3% YoY despite strong order book; analysts asked for FY27 growth guidance.

watchlist.response: Attributed to revenue stabilisation and wage hikes; said full impact was in Q4.
watchlist.text: U.S. and Middle East margins declined YoY and QoQ.

watchlist.response: Management said AI deals are building up and will improve as use cases become enterprise-scale, but gave no timeline.
watchlist.text: AI-led deals are small, around $1 million average size, raising scalability questions.

watchlist.response: Management said there is no clear directional number, only lead indicators, and exact timing is unknown.
watchlist.text: When will AI-driven workflow modernisation show up in order book or revenue?

watchlist.response: Attributed to delayed start of certain large deals due to political events (e.g., US federal government deal delayed post-midterm elections and UK government policy evaluation).
watchlist.text: Softness in 12-month order backlog and slower conversion of deals into revenue.
